notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Central Wyoming Fair & Rodeo, 307-235-5775, Tom Jones, with a December call reminder for Debbie. Adventure Zone has substantial Gmail history with this fair, including WAF/RMAF follow-up and direct 2025-26 outreach. The official 2026 fair ran July 3-11. Source: handwritten call notes page 81; Adventure Zone Gmail; current fair information.
